lastactivity.title: Last Activity
lastactivity.remarks: The timestamp of the most recent user activity for this session

adminlogout.title: Admin Logout
adminlogout.remarks: Indicates that the session has been administratively logged out.  Eventually, the row will be removed by the User Monitor in SecurityService.

clientaddr.title: Client Address
clientaddr.remarks: IP Address of the user's client (remote address).

active.title: Active
active.remarks: Indicates whether the session is active.

clienthost.title: Client Host
clienthost.remarks: Host name of the user's client (remote host).

application.title: Application
application.remarks: Indicates the application for a connection from external systems such as ERP, MEA, and MS Project. This has nothing to do with applications for internal connections such as Work Orders, Purchase Orders, Changes, etc.

displayname.title: Name
displayname.remarks: Display name from the Person record of the logged in user.

servertimestamp.title: Server Timestamp
servertimestamp.remarks: Timestamp of the Application Server to make sure the Application Server is running

serverhost.title: Server Host
serverhost.remarks: Host name or IP Address of the MXServer for this session

issystem.title: System
issystem.remarks: True if this is the session that MXServer connects to the database with. False for all other sessions. The System User setting on a User record has no bearing on this field.

reloadcache.title: Reload Cache
reloadcache.remarks: If this is a system connection, then reloadcache specifies which cache objects need to be reloaded (if any).
